The '''Bolenia system''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was the origin point of [[Bolenian hill-spinner]]s.<ref name="Reunion">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Bolenian hill-spinner]]s|system=Bolenia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bolenia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-9.<ref name="TEA" />
